title: Chicago's 5 hottest wards in summer
why: Everyone feels it, and the hot list (23, 13, 14) holds year after year while the lakefront and Ward 10 stay cool (high confidence).
caveat: Satellite surface temperature, not air temperature, from one summer. Tracks pavement and tree cover, so it is fair per ward. 2025 and 2026 differ in the exact top 5 but 23, 13, 14 recur 2022-2024.

title: Chicago's 5 cheapest wards to rent
why: Rent is the number one dinner-table topic and the bottom (Ward 42, 34, 43) is the downtown crowd.
caveat: Survey estimate (ACS 2023, medium confidence). Median covers all units, not apartments listed today.

title: Chicago's 5 safest wards (violent crime)
why: Guaranteed comments. Rate per 10,000 residents, full-year 2025.
caveat: Reported crime. Ward 42 is not at the extreme because the rate divides by residents, not visitors. Not the walking-safety episode: it counts assaults, battery, homicide and sexual assault, not crashes.

title: Chicago's 5 wards with the most bars
why: Ward 44 (Wrigleyville) and Ward 1 rank above Ward 32 and the rest, and Ward 42 leads. Bar-count arguments fill comments.
caveat: Count, so downtown and nightlife corridors win. Ward 42 leads partly because of non-residents. Google Maps sweep (high confidence).

title: Chicago's 5 wards with the fewest chain restaurants
why: Ward 11 (Bridgeport) at 6% is a surprise; Lincoln Park Ward 43 is not on the list.
caveat: Share, not count, so it is fair. Depends on what the sweep counted as a chain.

title: Chicago's 5 highest-income wards
why: Shareable and arguable (Ward 32 beats Ward 43).
caveat: ACS 2023 medium confidence. Household median is distorted in wards with many students or retirees.

title: Chicago's 5 wards that vote the most
why: Ward 19 (Beverly) beats every lakefront ward, and the bottom is a stark gap.
caveat: Only the 2023 municipal election (period end 2023-04-04) is available. Turnout is of registered voters.

title: Chicago's 5 wards with the most coffee shops
why: Easy 6-word stat, with Ward 42 at 186 and Ward 8 at 6.
caveat: Count, so downtown wins by volume. Per-10k version (licensed_coffee_shops_per_10000_residents) puts Ward 11 in the top 4.

title: Chicago's 5 wards that fix potholes fastest
top: W3 0.4 days, W42 0.9 days, W9 2.1 days, W34 2.3 days, W49 2.9 days
bottom: W24 50.0 days, W26 44.8 days, W33 39.0 days
why: Everyone hates potholes. Ward 24 is the slowest in 2022, 2025 and 2026.
caveat: Confidence unrated. The ranking swings by year (weather and crew timing) and tiny ward samples make Ward 3 at 0.4 days suspect. 2026 is partial through 29 Sep. Say the year on screen.

title: Chicago's 5 sunniest wards (fewest shadows)
why: Fresh, visual: Ward 42 gets 57% of the sun and 40% on the winter solstice.
caveat: Confidence unrated. Modeled from building heights, so it reflects tall buildings, not weather. Downtown is naturally lowest.

title: Chicago's 5 wards where the alderman shows up least
why: Names an alderman. Ward 27 at 41% is eye-catching.
caveat: Medium confidence. Several wards tie at 97%, so the top is a tie. Excused absences may not be counted. Name carefully.

title: Chicago's 5 wards with the fewest cars per home
why: The car-free map: Ward 2, 34, 42 below 0.7 cars per home.
caveat: Confidence unrated. Mostly a density story, not choice. Pair with the L map.

title: Chicago's 5 wards with the most new businesses
why: Wards 25 (Pilsen) and 12 in the top 5 are the surprise.
caveat: Per resident, so downtown inflates. Based on licence openings (medium confidence).

title: Chicago's 5 wards with the most languages at home
why: Ward 50 (West Rogers Park) on top is a surprise. Warm, positive topic.
caveat: ACS 2023 medium confidence. Score is an index (not a count of languages).

title: Chicago's 5 wards with the most murals
why: Uptown's Ward 46 leads Ward 32 and Ward 4.
caveat: Registered murals only, so wards with active artist groups register more. Cumulative count, not a 2026 total.

title: Chicago's 5 wards with the longest commutes
why: Everyone commutes. Southeast and Southwest side wards 7, 9, 18, 10, 8 top the list, while downtown wards have the shortest.
caveat: ACS 2023 medium. Share of workers over 45 minutes, not average time.

title: Chicago's 5 most rent-burdened wards
why: Ward 18 at 63% (rent takes 30%+ of income) is a surprise.
caveat: ACS 2023 medium. Share of renter households only, so wards with few renters have small samples.

title: How far is each ward from the Bean?
why: Fun and viral map. Ward 41 is 16 miles away.
caveat: Confidence unrated. Distance from ward center. Playful, not a quality ranking.

title: Chicago's 5 wards with the highest school spending per student
why: Spending does not follow wealth: Ward 43 and 47 are near the bottom.
caveat: Medium confidence. School attendance areas do not line up with ward lines. Includes selective-enrollment effects.

title: Chicago's 5 wards getting the least sleep
why: Quirky and relatable. Wards 17, 16, 24 are the weariest.
caveat: Modeled CDC estimates (2022, medium), not a survey of each ward. Differences are narrow.
